title: OKDP mapping sections
description: The sections of a mapping (values.cel.yaml) the OKDP compiler reads, once evaluated: every compile checks them after the mapping and reports every violation at once. okdpGeneratedSecret is not a section: it is the argument of the host function, checked at each call. let and errors are the mapping language's. A null is not set (a section, a key of a map this schema describes): it is dropped before the check.

output.description: Chart key -> the values the mapping computes for the chart, a map; a null chart is left out, as by $if. Each key must be a chart of service.yaml, checked with the final values.

instance.description: The instance, in the descriptor ConfigMap. Other keys are ignored.

usage.description: How to use the instance, trimmed, with one final newline.

provides.description: The connections the instance publishes, each then checked against its contract.

items.description: An output. Other keys are ignored.

name.description: The output's name, unique per contract; the release name when absent or empty.

secretRef.description: The Secret holding the secret fields: {} is not set; only name is kept. Absent, the Secret of secret, <name>-<contract>-credentials.

secret.description: The credentials Secret the compiler renders, named after secretRef: generated (generate, the keys of okdpGeneratedSecret, and stringData) or plain (stringData, strings only). Other keys are ignored.

objects.description: OKDP's own objects, whole manifests, passed as written.

oidcClients.description: The OAuth clients of the service. The compiler then checks that one client at most has no name (the main client), that names are unique and, in dcr mode, that no two clients write one Secret.

name.description: "" or absent: the service's main client. Else the client's name, a DNS label of 54 characters at most: it names the chart <name>-oidc-dcr (a DNS label), its objects and its Secret.

grantTypes.description: The OAuth grant types the client registers.

scope.description: The scope it requests; "" or absent: platform.oidc.scope.

clientName.description: Its name at the identity provider; "" or absent: <release>-<namespace>[-<name>].

public.description: A public client, without a client secret; absent: false.

request.description: Fields of the registration request, over the computed ones.

secret.description: The Secret the Job writes the client to; "" or absent: oidcClientSecret(<name>).

caSecret.description: The Secret holding the CA bundle the Job trusts; "" or absent: platform.oidc.dcr.caSecret.

okdpGeneratedSecret.description: Not a section: the argument of okdpGeneratedSecret, the objects of a Secret whose random values External Secrets Operator generates.

name.description: The Secret, and the ExternalSecret writing it.

labels.description: Extra labels of the ExternalSecret and the Secret.

namespace.description: The namespace of every object; "" or absent: the release's.

refreshInterval.description: The ExternalSecret's refresh interval; "" or absent: "0", generated once.

apiVersion.description: The ExternalSecret's apiVersion; "" or absent: external-secrets.io/v1.

generatedKey.description: A generated key: the key of the Secret, and the Password generating its value.

transform.description: The key holds the value's sha256sum, or its base64; "" or absent: the value.
